messages.subject: redundant code
parts:
Hi,
I am using revolution r 7.4.1. When debugging a syntax which contains "quote" function, it always produce redundant code in the result. Like

    {
        if (.Revo.tb("F:/StatCourse/Simulation/1.R|214|0"))
            browser()
    }

Please see the attached example. How to avoid this? Thank you!

In testing, please set breakpoint next to "point" in the "2.R". Then Run "call.R" in debug mode. As it stops at "point", check the variable "code" which contains redundant code like above.
